name: CMS Starter
description: An Onyx-backed editorial CMS with drafts, revisions, media, role-based publishing and a server-rendered SEO website.
useWhen: A single public website needs a self-hosted editorial CMS, strong technical SEO and Onyx persistence
avoidWhen: The primary product is an admin dashboard or a different framework/database is required
capabilities: Pages and posts with private working drafts and immutable revisions
Server-enforced administrator, editor and author roles
Lexical rich text and tables; static public rendering
Onyx document media with owner and public visibility checks
Content-referenced navigation and editable site settings
Server-rendered metadata, canonical URLs, JSON-LD, feeds and sharded sitemaps

requiredEnvironment: Existing Onyx downloaded configuration via SDK resolver
